title: A-Finance
tagline: An Defi agent which makes your finance on web3 as easy as web2!
description: This app was aiming to build a gasless, cross-chain "DeFi agent wallet" that makes decentralized finance feel like a Web2 payments experience. Users deposit USDC once to open a Yellow session, then can send instant micro-payments without paying gas each time. A rule-based agent automatically chooses the best chain and route via LI.FI, then executes swaps or portfolio actions on Uniswap v4, finally settling balances on chain the user wishes when the session closes.
how_its_made: The app is built as a modern Web3 dashboard focused on clean UX and wallet identity. The interface is created with a component based frontend architecture that connects to user wallets and resolves ENS names to human readable profiles. Navigation, layouts, and state management were designed first, allowing future APIs and agent logic to plug in seamlessly. The current version demonstrates wallet connectivity, ENS redirection, and structured UI flows that will later host session payments, cross-chain actions, and DeFi automation features.
